causal_hypothesis: Inconclusive between pregrasp misalignment and gripper/contact execution. Evidence supports a post-closure retention failure, but cannot uniquely identify the initiating layer.

critic_rules.proposal: A closed gripper has sustained absent contact, no retained grasp, and no meaningful lift for 12 physical actions after the closure event; autonomous recovery has not occurred. Interrupt nominal execution and request one bounded open-settle-replan recovery for a safe approach retry.
critic_rules.title: Sustained post-closure noncontact and no retention

mechanism_change: Bounded provisional hypothesis test: retain the post-closure no-retention detector but require a longer sustained no-contact/no-grasp window, then insert one bounded open-gripper settling verification before fresh Zeva replanning. This tests whether the rejected recovery replanned before the gripper had reached a safely open, retry-ready state.

recovery_rules.fallback: If opening, settling verification, or Zeva replanning cannot establish its stated predicate within the bounded recovery horizon, invoke arx.finish with reason "alignment open-settle recovery exhausted".
recovery_rules.precondition: The critic has interrupted execution with gripper_closed=1, gripper_contact<=0.5, grasped=0, lift_m<=0.02, and success=0 sustained for its dwell window.
safety_constraints: Actor remains the sole environment writer; the critic only proposes interruption and recovery.
Do not invoke this recovery again while token alignment_open_settle_once is active. The 50-step cooldown covers the maximum 20 gripper actions, 5 settling actions, and up to 20 Zeva physical actions.
Abort recovery if privileged.interaction.success becomes 1, the environment ends, or a safety supervisor interrupts.
Use only the frozen bounded tools and policy-inferred motion; provide no absolute coordinates.

steps.stop_when: The five-step settle window completes with privileged.interaction.gripper_closed at 0, privileged.interaction.grasped at 0, and privileged.interaction.success at 0.

Fresh Zeva observation and bounded replanning complete while privileged.interaction.gripper_closed is 0, privileged.interaction.grasped is 0, and privileged.interaction.success is 0; nominal continuation may retry approach.

recovery_rules.stop_condition: Stop on official success or environment termination; otherwise hand control back only after the gripper is observably open, grasped remains false, the settling predicate holds, and fresh Zeva replanning completes.
recovery_rules.title: Open, verify settling, and freshly replan pregrasp

validation_plan: Run paired same-seed nominal versus candidate trials through official termination, meeting the authorization requirement of at least two same-seed candidate successes. Log gripper_closed, gripper_contact, grasped, lift_m, success, target-to-gripper deltas, recovery step completions, and all requested/processed/measured actions. Attribute a rescue only to official evaluator success after this rule fires. The distinguishing live-gate test is whether the added open-and-settle verification increases successful recoveries without safety events. Falsify the leading alignment hypothesis if aligned closure yields sustained contact and grasped becomes true but is subsequently lost while closure/contact remain sustained; falsify this recovery refinement if sustained no-contact/no-grasp interventions complete the open-hold-Zeva sequence yet do not improve attributed rescues versus nominal.
